intro: The NXTutors area pages for this eastern zone cover Gomti Nagar, Gomti Nagar Extension, Indira Nagar and Chinhat. Each has its own housing pattern. Indira Nagar, one of the largest planned colonies in the city, is chiefly independent houses and builder floors on plotted lanes, organised in sectors and lettered blocks around markets such as Bhootnath and Lekhraj. Older Gomti Nagar pairs plotted homes on wide sector roads with apartment blocks, gated complexes and busy commercial strips. The Extension is still developing, with authority flats, private high-rise towers and gated townships. Chinhat, on the highway towards Ayodhya, adds independent houses and plots, with newer townships along the main road.

Travel differs sharply across the zone. The Red Line runs through Indira Nagar, so a tutor from Hazratganj, Charbagh or the Kanpur Road side can reach the colony by metro and walk or take an auto, and Gomti Nagar families on the Indira Nagar side gain from that too. Deeper into Gomti Nagar, and throughout the Extension and Chinhat, there is no station, so tutors come by car, two-wheeler or auto; Gomti Nagar railway station and Malhaur station help only a few. Shaheed Path, Faizabad Road and the commercial roads of Gomti Nagar are busiest at office hours, which favours an early-evening or weekend slot.

Requests from this zone are matched from the inside out. NXTutors looks first at tutors living in these localities, then at tutors who already travel here, then at the rest of Lucknow, and finally at online tutors. In the Extension and Chinhat, where the metro does not reach, a tutor from the same sectors or from Gomti Nagar is the realistic choice for weekly visits, and an online specialist can take a senior subject. State the board and, for UP Board, the medium. You will see two or three matched tutors with fees shown before you book, the first class is a free demo, and switching tutor later is free.
faqs: Which parts of this zone does the metro serve?

Mainly Indira Nagar and the Gomti Nagar khands beside it. Munshi Pulia, Indira Nagar, Bhootnath Market and Lekhraj Market stations on the Red Line all lie in or next to Indira Nagar, and nearby Gomti Nagar families use them as well. The Extension and Chinhat have no station, so tutors there arrive by car, two-wheeler or auto.
How are Gomti Nagar addresses organised?

By khand in older Gomti Nagar, where every khand name starts with the letter V, Vibhuti Khand or Vivek Khand for example, and by numbered sector in the Extension along Shaheed Path. Give the khand or sector, the plot or house number and, for an apartment complex, the tower and flat, so the tutor finds you first time.
Is Chinhat practical for a home tutor?

Yes, for tutors living nearby. Chinhat sits on the eastern edge where Shaheed Path meets Faizabad Road, and it has no metro station, so most tutors come by road from Gomti Nagar, Indira Nagar or neighbouring colonies. Independent houses mean a doorstep visit with parking on the lane; townships along the highway register visitors at the gate.
What does the free demo involve?

The first lesson with the tutor you pick is a free demo, taught as an ordinary class on whatever chapter your child is doing now. You see the tutor's fee on the profile before you book it. If the demo shows a poor fit, try the next of your two or three matches, and changing tutor later is free too.

intro: North of the Gomti, this zone holds the NXTutors area pages for Mahanagar, Nishatganj, Nirala Nagar, Kapoorthala, Aliganj, Vikas Nagar, Jankipuram and Jankipuram Extension. Plotted houses are the backbone. Mahanagar is an established mix of houses, villas and apartment buildings where most homes change hands as resale, Nirala Nagar is an upmarket layout of parks and wide roads, and Nishatganj and Kapoorthala put market roads in front of lanes of houses and flats. Aliganj, among the largest localities in the north of the city, is mostly independent houses, and further out Jankipuram and its Vistar add villas, townships, apartment towers and plots that are still being built on.

The Red Line touches only the southern edge. Badshahnagar, IT College and Vishwavidyalaya stations are within reach of Mahanagar, Nishatganj, Nirala Nagar and Kapoorthala, so tutors from Hazratganj or Indira Nagar can ride in and finish by auto. Aliganj's nearest stop is Badshahnagar, and beyond it Vikas Nagar, Jankipuram and the Extension rely on Sitapur Road, Kursi Road and the Ring Road, where evening traffic slows cross-town trips. That makes a tutor who lives north of the river far easier to keep on a weekday. In the busier market pockets, a weekend morning is often the simplest time for the first demo.

For a request from this zone, NXTutors first checks tutors who live north of the Gomti in these localities, then tutors who already travel here, then the wider city, and then online tutors. Families in Jankipuram Extension, where some sectors are still filling up, often combine a home tutor for school subjects with online classes for exam preparation or a specialist subject. Mention the board and, for UP Board, the medium of teaching, so the match fits your child's classroom. Every shortlist has two or three tutors with fees on the profile before you book, the first lesson is a free demo, and switching later costs nothing.
faqs: Why is there no metro station in Mahanagar?

A Mahanagar station was planned but left out of the final Red Line route. The area is served instead by Badshahnagar and IT College stations, both opened in March 2019, and Badshahnagar also connects with the railway station of the same name. A tutor can ride the metro and take a short auto ride or walk to your door.
Is Aliganj mostly houses or flats?

Mostly houses. Aliganj is one of the largest localities in north Lucknow, planned in lettered sectors, and most homes are independent houses on plotted layouts, with some apartments and plots. That means a doorstep visit with no gate register. Sitapur Road, Kursi Road, Purania Road and the Ring Road at Tedhi Pulia connect it with the rest of the city.
Can a tutor reach Jankipuram without the metro?

Yes, by road. Jankipuram has no station and the nearest Red Line stops lie well to the south, so tutors come by two-wheeler, car or auto. Plotted lanes have parking outside, while towers and townships register visitors at the gate. For weekday evenings, a tutor on the same side of the Ring Road is easiest to keep.
Who decides the tutor's fee?

Each tutor sets their own hourly fee, and it appears on the profile of every matched tutor before you book, so you can compare cost with experience and board. Senior classes and entrance preparation usually sit higher than primary help. The first lesson is a free demo, and later switches to another tutor carry no charge.

intro: The old heart of Lucknow forms this zone, with NXTutors area pages for Hazratganj, Lalbagh, Aminabad, Aishbagh, Chowk and Rajendra Nagar. Few families here live in houses with their own gate. Most homes are flats above shopfronts or in older buildings on side streets, often without a lift or a guard, and banks, hotels and offices share the roads. Quieter residential pockets lie around Hazratganj in neighbouring colonies such as Hasanganj. Aishbagh mixes historic buildings with newer apartment blocks and a few villas, Chowk is a dense market district of narrow lanes, and Rajendra Nagar is largely mid-rise apartments close to Charbagh.

For a tutor, the metro is the steadiest way in. Hazratganj, Sachivalaya in Lalbagh and Hussainganj are underground Red Line stations, and Charbagh serves Rajendra Nagar and Aishbagh, so a tutor from Indira Nagar, Alambagh or the airport side can ride in and walk the last stretch. Aminabad and Chowk still wait for the Blue Line, which is under construction, so two-wheelers and autos cover those lanes, where cars struggle to park. Market crowds swell in the late afternoon and evening, and Charbagh is busy at train and office times, which favours weekday afternoons, weekend mornings or online sessions.

When a family in this zone asks for a tutor, NXTutors starts with tutors living in the old centre, then those who already travel here, often by metro, then tutors elsewhere in Lucknow, and finally online tutors. A tutor who rides the Red Line suits Hazratganj, Lalbagh and Rajendra Nagar, while one on a two-wheeler suits the lanes of Chowk and Aminabad. Older students who want a specialist for a board or entrance subject can keep the home tutor and add online classes. You will be shown two or three matched tutors, each fee visible before booking; the first class is a free demo and switching later is free.
faqs: Which metro stations are closest to Hazratganj and Lalbagh?

Hazratganj station sits in the market district itself, Sachivalaya station is in Lalbagh, and Hussainganj is one stop along. All three are underground stations on the Red Line. A tutor coming from Indira Nagar, Alambagh or Charbagh can ride in and walk the last part, which avoids the parking problem on the market streets.
Is there a metro to Aminabad or Chowk?

Not yet. The Blue Line from Charbagh to Vasant Kunj, approved in August 2025, is under construction and planned to serve Aminabad, Pandeyganj and Chowk. Until it opens, Sachivalaya is the nearest working station for Aminabad, and tutors reach both markets by two-wheeler, auto or on foot, since cars struggle in the lanes.
Do flats in the old centre have guards at the gate?

Many do not. Buildings above or behind shops often have no guard and sometimes no lift, so there is no register to sign, but the tutor may need to call from the ground floor on arrival. Newer apartment buildings in Aishbagh and Rajendra Nagar may keep a visitor book at the entrance instead, and parking inside their compounds is easier.
How much do home tutors in central Lucknow charge?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Tutors set their exact rates, and each one is shown on the profile before the free demo.

intro: The Kanpur Road side of south Lucknow makes up this zone, with NXTutors area pages for Alambagh, Ashiyana, Rajajipuram, LDA Colony, Krishna Nagar and Sarojini Nagar. It is largely plotted-house country. Ashiyana, Krishna Nagar and the LDA Colony sectors are dominated by independent houses on sector lanes, with some villas, authority flats and apartments. Rajajipuram, laid out in blocks with wide roads and parks, adds mid-rise and high-rise flats, hostels and paying-guest homes. Alambagh is busier, mixing houses, builder floors, apartments and a few gated communities around a large morning vegetable market, and Sarojini Nagar on the airport side includes state housing board flats.

No part of Lucknow has had metro service longer: the Red Line began here, and Alambagh, Alambagh ISBT, Singar Nagar, Krishna Nagar and Transport Nagar stations lie within or beside the zone, with Amausi towards the airport end. A tutor from Hazratganj or Indira Nagar can ride south and finish by auto. The Alambagh bus terminal, the largest in the city, and Alamnagar railway station near Rajajipuram add more ways in. Kanpur Road is the pressure point, heaviest at office hours in both directions, so the lesson should sit clear of that peak rather than force the tutor through it.

NXTutors fills a shortlist for this zone from tutors living in these colonies first, then tutors who already travel to your sector or block, then the rest of Lucknow, and online tutors last. Because the metro runs along Kanpur Road, the second ring is wider here than in much of the city, and a tutor from the old centre can realistically commit to weekly visits. Senior students can pair the home tutor with an online specialist for a board or entrance subject. Name the board, and the medium if it is UP Board. You will get two or three matched tutors with visible fees, a free demo as the first class, and free switching later.
faqs: Is Rajajipuram easy for a tutor to find?

Usually, yes. Rajajipuram is laid out in lettered blocks from A to F with wide roads and parks, so the block letter plus the house number normally does the job. Houses allow a doorstep arrival with parking outside, and apartment buildings may keep a visitor book. Alambagh metro station and Alamnagar railway station are the nearest rail links.
Does Alambagh have many gated communities?

A few. Alambagh is mostly independent houses, builder floors and apartments, with some gated communities among them. In a house the tutor comes straight to the door; in a gated community the guard keeps a visitor register, so share the tutor's name beforehand. The morning vegetable market and Kanpur Road traffic are worth avoiding when setting the lesson time.
How do tutors reach Sarojini Nagar near the airport?

By metro or by road. Amausi and the airport station form the southern end of the Red Line, and Transport Nagar station also serves this side of Kanpur Road, so a tutor can ride down and take an auto. Others drive along the highway. Apartment complexes register visitors at the entrance, while independent homes allow parking at the gate.
Can I change tutor if my child does not get on with the first one?

Yes, and it costs nothing. Start with the free demo, which lets your child sit one real lesson before you pay anything, and compare the two or three matched tutors, whose fees are on their profiles in advance. If the chosen tutor stops working out later in the year, NXTutors offers another match.

intro: The south-eastern edge of Lucknow forms this zone, with NXTutors area pages for Sushant Golf City, Vrindavan Yojana and Telibagh. The three places show three housing patterns. Sushant Golf City is a large township on Shaheed Path and the Sultanpur highway, planned around a golf course and made up mostly of apartments in gated towers, with plots, villas and condominiums around commercial blocks on its main avenue. Vrindavan Yojana, a state housing board township on Raebareli Road, spreads across numbered sectors of apartments, houses, builder floors and plots. Telibagh, just beside it, is a quieter neighbourhood where independent houses make up most homes.

No metro serves this belt, and the nearest Red Line stop, Transport Nagar, is over on Kanpur Road, so every home lesson depends on a tutor with a two-wheeler, a car or a cab. Shaheed Path is the spine, carrying tutors from Gomti Nagar and the Kanpur Road side, while Raebareli Road links Telibagh and Vrindavan Yojana with the city centre and the airport side. Both roads are busy at school and office times, and the commercial stretches of the township fill in the evening. A fixed slot agreed in advance, a little after the school-run traffic has cleared, is the easiest to keep week after week.

Because distance matters so much here, NXTutors searches outward carefully: tutors living in these townships first, then tutors who already make the trip along Shaheed Path or Raebareli Road, then the rest of Lucknow, and online tutors last. For many families the answer is a home tutor from the same belt for everyday school subjects, with an online specialist when a senior subject calls for someone who lives across the city. Each request brings two or three matched tutors whose fees you see before booking. The first lesson is a free demo, and if the match does not suit your child, switching tutor is free.
faqs: Is there a metro near Sushant Golf City?

No. The township has no station, and the nearest Red Line stop is Transport Nagar on Kanpur Road. Tutors come by car, two-wheeler or cab, usually along Shaheed Path from Gomti Nagar, Vrindavan Yojana or Telibagh. Choosing a tutor who already lives in or near the township makes a weekly routine much easier to keep.
What housing will a tutor find in Vrindavan Yojana?

A mix. Vrindavan Yojana is a planned township of the UP Awas Vikas Parishad on Raebareli Road, divided into numbered sectors across several schemes, with apartments, independent houses, builder floors and residential plots. Houses let a tutor park outside; apartment complexes register visitors at the gate. Share the sector number with the address for the first visit.
Do tutors need gate passes in Telibagh?

Rarely. Telibagh is mainly independent houses, with some plots, builder floors and apartments, and most homes open straight onto the lane, so there is no gate to clear and parking outside is simple. Apartment buildings are the exception. Raebareli Road links the area with the city centre and the airport side, and it slows at school times.
What happens after I send a request?

NXTutors matches your child's class, board, subjects and location against the tutors nearest to you and returns two or three options, each with the fee on the profile. You pick one for a free demo lesson. If the fit is right you continue; if not, or if it changes later, you can switch tutor at no cost.
